subject: POC mode scout report — next-phase plan for MedTech Labs
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Anna Zhao <anna@medtechlabs.com>, MedTech Labs Procurement <procurement@medtechlabs.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-25T16:12:00-07:00
Subject: POC mode scoping for MedTech Labs — next steps

Hi Anna / MedTech team,

Thanks again for the call earlier — great discussion diving into latency needs, PHI boundaries, and your expected throughput for the clinical notes summarization feature. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can align on the POC mode (Hosted API vs Dedicated vs Private VPC):

Summary of constraints we captured:
- PHI / regulatory: you need HIPAA controls and customer-managed keying for any PHI in flight or at rest.
- Latency: 95th percentile under 400ms for short prompts (~200 tokens) for interactive clinician flows.
- Volume: pilot will peak ~1k requests/day with burst to 3k/day during rollouts.

Recommended POC paths (two parallel options to shorten time-to-evidence):
1) Hosted quick-run: spin up a short hosted trial with redwood's verified model profile to validate prompt/accuracy and basic latency (fast, low friction, no KMS).
2) Private VPC pilot: deploy a scoped Private control plane with VPC peering and customer KMS for end-to-end PHI proof points (longer lead time — needs security sign-off).

Ask / next steps:
- Please confirm whether MedTech wants us to prioritize Hosted (fast validation) or Private VPC (compliance-first). If Private VPC, share the security contact so we can start the connectivity checklist.
- If you prefer Hosted first, we can run a 7–10 day accuracy/latency run and deliver the success criteria doc attached.

I've attached a draft success-criteria workbook and a short Private VPC pilot outline for your review. Proposed decision target: 2027-04-29 so we can schedule engineering slots the week of 2027-05-03.

Attaching: medtech_poc_success_criteria.xlsx, redwood_private_vpc_poc_plan.pdf

Thanks — happy to jump on another quick call if helpful.

Best,
Monica Patel
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0198
From: Anna Zhao <anna@medtechlabs.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: MedTech Labs Procurement <procurement@medtechlabs.com>
Date: 2027-04-26T09:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC mode scoping for MedTech Labs — next steps

Thanks Monica — quick answers from our side: we appreciate the two-track approach. A few clarifications: 

1) Compliance preference: Private VPC is preferred because the initial dataset contains PHI we cannot risk leaving under vendor-managed keys. We will need KMS integration and audit logs.
2) Timeline constraints: Security review window opens 2027-05-05 and we'd like the POC to be in a staging-like environment before that window closes.
3) Stakeholders: security@medtechlabs.com (SOC2 lead), devops@medtechlabs.com (network/peering), and procurement (cc'd) will be involved.

Can you confirm what minimum artifacts Redwood needs to start Private VPC prep (network ranges, certs, contact for peering)? Also, if Hosted is strictly required to unblock model validation, are there obfuscated-data alternatives that would avoid PHI risk?

Anna
Anna Zhao
Director, Product — Clinical AI
Anna.Zhao@medtechlabs.com
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Anna Zhao <anna@medtechlabs.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, MedTech Labs Procurement <procurement@medtechlabs.com>
Date: 2027-04-27T11:37:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC mode scoping for MedTech Labs — next steps

Anna — perfect, thanks for the clarity. Next-phase proposal to keep momentum:

A) Private VPC pilot (primary path) — what we will provision / ask for:
- Kickoff checklist: networking CIDR, peering contact, KMS ARN (we support AWS KMS/HSM), and an approved IP allowlist.
- Deliverables: Private control plane in your VPC, audit log access, TLS certs, and a small dedicated pod to run the inference engine (sized for 1–3k RPS bursts).
- Timeline: security-ready kickoff on 2027-05-05, 2–3 weeks to standing pilot (target 2027-05-19) assuming approvals and peering windows.

B) Hosted obfuscated-data validation (parallel, optional):
- If you want an early signal on model quality we can run a hosted pass using tokenized/hashed records you provide (no raw PHI). Takes 5–7 business days.

Success criteria (attached workbook) we propose to measure POC success:
- Accuracy: clinician F1 >= 0.82 on the provided validation set
- Latency: 95p < 400ms for 200-token prompts under pilot traffic profile
- Security: KMS integration + audit log ingestion validated by your security team
- Ops: automated CVR and per-request tracing visible in Redwood Console

Action items (can you confirm by 2027-04-29):
- Which path do you want as the priority (Private VPC pilot vs Hosted obfuscated validation)?
- Security contact and network peering owner email so we can send the checklist.

Ben / Lauren — looping you in for pricing and engineering capacity. Ben, please flag any constraints on the 2–3 week pilot window and a preliminary estimate for a dedicated pilot pod.

Thanks — I will schedule a short 30-min kickoff for next Thursday if Anna confirms.

Best,
Monica
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>

Date: 2027-04-28T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC mode scoping for MedTech Labs — next steps

Quick internal note and reply to the thread:

Monica / Anna — pricing and capacity takeaways for the Private VPC pilot:
- Estimated pilot footprint: 1 dedicated small GPU pod (NVIDIA A10-equivalent) with autoscale for short bursts.
- Ballpark commit for pilot (infrastructure + support): $7,500–$9,000 for the 3-week engagement (we'll provide a formal pilot SOW once scope confirmed).
- Engineering: 3 full days to do initial provisioning + peering, then intermittent support during test window. The 2–3 week target is feasible but depends on timely peering approvals.

Two small asks on schedule: 
1) If security can't start the week of 2027-05-05, the earliest we can guarantee the 2027-05-19 standing pilot is slipping by ~7–10 days.
2) For the Hosted obfuscated path, we can run it immediately once you upload the hashed validation set to the drive link Monica shared.

I'll draft the quick SOW and pilot cost sheet after Monica confirms which path we prioritize.

-Ben
